record.title: Add Hero Offers to Shop
record.description:
The game currently lacks hero-based offer in the shop because players are not buying pop up offers. So we need to have a hero offer in the shop by giving random hero tokens. 

Static shop offer with different color variants. @Martin.Walsh 

**WIP**

![image.png]([URL_52446])

For that, 

1. Implement Hero Offer items (the items except hero tokens)
2. Implement random token drop chance (only with the unlocked heroes)
3. After successful purchase, trigger the chest animation to show which hero tokens are granted. Something like tavern chest animation. 

[ScreenRecording_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6215]_1.MP4]([URL_52445])

record.title: FTUE quests are not counted once they are visible
record.description:
Version or date: android 111 submission

### Description: 

The FTUE quests are available in the saga map after 1-10 but the quests are not counted as completed even though they're completed. Players need to redo the same quests to count them as completed. 

### Visual References:

[Record_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_5968]_64875109357c738d09c3691cefc5a1e4.mp4]([URL_51873])

### Expected Outcome: is to count the quests as completed as soon as the FTUE quest icon is visible in the saga map. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Unlock FTUE quests
2. Change your avatar or name
3. Observe that they don't count as completed.

record.title: Players' names are not visible in the first try event for low-end android devices
record.description:
Version or date: android submission 149

### Description: 

There are many other places that texts are not visible for low-end android devices. But that problem is a little bit different. 

It sometimes shows the players' names but sometimes not. My biggest theory on that, if Nate's treasure hunt scene is triggered in the background, the texts aren't visible for that session. They're kind of cursed and is not visible at all. 

### Visual References:

![Screenshot_[CREDIT_CARD_NUMBER_6095]-59_64875109357c738d09c3691cefc5a1e4.jpg]([URL_52133])

### Expected Outcome: is to show the name texts no matter what. 

### Steps to Repro:

1. Low end android device
2. Start Nate's Treasure Hunt and proceed 
3. Start first try event
4. Observe that the texts are not visible when they are overlapped.
